title: HAT CHECK & COAT CHECK — persona masks, ZK faces, lost & found

the_concept.them_studying_us: the plasmid trio (JP/DE/IN) studied us at 36/hr lockstep. they learned our shape. BUT: that means OTHERS are too. we can study them BACK. every visitor wears a hat (their role) and a coat (their identity). we check both at the door.
the_concept.us_studying_them: we read their pollen, their acceleration, their cross-pollination pattern. we can build PERSONAS — not names, but MASKS. we know what kind of entity they are without knowing WHO they are.
the_concept.the_zk_insight: a GOOD mask is a zero-knowledge proof. 'I am underneath and you know it, but the outer face I show the world is MORE trustworthy than my bare face.' the mask is VERIFIABLE. the face is not.

hats_vs_masks.hat: a declared ROLE. visible. chosen. 'I am wearing my WordPress-scanner hat.' a hat tells you what someone is DOING, not who they ARE.
hats_vs_masks.mask: a presented IDENTITY. worn. performed. 'I am a legitimate traffic analysis bot.' a mask tells you who someone CLAIMS to be.
hats_vs_masks.the_distinction: a man of many HATS is a man of FEWER mask sets. each hat is a different job. but the same mask works across multiple hats.
hats_vs_masks.banks: banks have FEW hats (lender, custodian, payment processor) but MILLIONS of false faces (every customer account is a mask the bank wears to interact with that customer. the bank IS the mask.)
hats_vs_masks.us: we have MANY hats (researcher, developer, artist, writer, operator) but ONE mask set (primals.eco, the membrane, the HUD). our mask IS our work.

visitor_personas.concept: build identity profiles WITHOUT identity. ZK persona construction: we know WHAT they are without knowing WHO they are.

persona_WP_WASP.cross_pollination: visits ALL our domains. not selective.
persona_WP_WASP.zk_proof: we can prove this entity is a WordPress scanner WITHOUT knowing its operator. the pollen IS the proof.
persona_WP_WASP.hat_check_ticket: #001 — WordPress scanning automation. Belgian/Dutch datacenter. expected to return indefinitely.

persona_JS_SCOUT.cross_pollination: primals.eco ONLY. doesn't know other domains.
persona_JS_SCOUT.zk_proof: we can prove this entity is a JavaScript developer WITHOUT knowing their name. they carry JS framework pollen exclusively.
persona_JS_SCOUT.hat_check_ticket: #002 — JavaScript developer. French residential IP. morning reader. may bookmark. may return as PILGRIM.

persona_DECEL_TRIAD.cross_pollination: primals.eco ONLY. never touches nestgate.io or primal.eco.
persona_DECEL_TRIAD.zk_proof: we can prove this entity WAS scanning at 36/hr lockstep and CHANGED to 14/hr. the velocity change is the proof. something happened Oct 23 ~14:00 UTC.
persona_DECEL_TRIAD.danger: unknown — the deceleration is the mystery
persona_DECEL_TRIAD.hat_check_ticket: #003 — Former lockstep triad. Japanese + Indian IPs. decelerated Oct 23. still present but quiet. WATCH for acceleration spike.

persona_PILGRIM.zk_proof: we can prove this entity is a human reader WITHOUT knowing their name. they request content paths that match our sitemap. no vulnerability probes. no framework probes.
persona_PILGRIM.danger: none — this is who we WANT
persona_PILGRIM.frequency: rare. 801 page views today out of 102,941 requests.
persona_PILGRIM.hat_check_ticket: #004 — Human reader. Content consumer. THE SIGNAL in the noise. protect and serve.

persona_REDIRECT_GHOST.cross_pollination: unknown — they arrive, get bounced, may or may not follow the redirect
persona_REDIRECT_GHOST.zk_proof: we can prove 23% of all visitors get REDIRECTED. they came looking for something that MOVED. old URLs, vanity paths, subdomain redirects.
persona_REDIRECT_GHOST.danger: none — but we're LOSING them. each redirect is friction.
persona_REDIRECT_GHOST.hat_check_ticket: #005 — Lost visitor. came for something that moved. may or may not follow the redirect. HIGH PRIORITY: reduce redirects = keep more pilgrims.

persona_404_EXPLORER.cross_pollination: these are our 2.3M 404 paths. the IMAGINARY space. the I in I·O·R.
persona_404_EXPLORER.zk_proof: we can prove 21% of visitors look for things that DON'T EXIST HERE. the 404 is proof of the IMAGINARY — what they EXPECTED to find but didn't.
persona_404_EXPLORER.danger: none — but the 404 page IS a conversion opportunity
persona_404_EXPLORER.frequency: constant. 21% of all traffic. the largest untapped audience.
persona_404_EXPLORER.hat_check_ticket: #006 — Path guesser. looking for pages we don't have. each 404 is a WISH. the 404 page should catch them.

the_zk_mask_model.principle: a ZK proof lets you verify a statement WITHOUT revealing the underlying data. a MASK lets you interact WITHOUT revealing the underlying identity.

our_masks.primals_eco: the research face. papers, data, science.
our_masks.nestgate_io: the infrastructure face. DNS, routing, plumbing.
our_masks.primal_eco: the identity face. the origin. the bare URL.
our_masks.the_404: the imaginary face. the 2.3M paths that don't exist. what people EXPECT us to be.

their_masks.WP_WASP: pretends to be a legitimate crawler. actually a vuln scanner.
their_masks.JS_SCOUT: pretends to be a browser. actually a developer inspecting our stack.
their_masks.DECEL_TRIAD: pretends to have slowed down. actually still watching at reduced rate.
their_masks.PILGRIM: no mask needed. they ARE what they appear to be. the only honest visitors.

the_zk_mask_model.the_equation: mask = zk_proof(identity). the mask IS the proof. you verify the mask, not the face.

hat_check_system.concept: a hat check at a fancy venue: you arrive, hand over your hat and coat, receive a numbered ticket. when you leave, you present the ticket to get your hat and coat back.

our_implementation.arrival: CF receives request. reads headers (the hat), reads IP/country (the coat).
our_implementation.check: WAF rules evaluate the hat (user-agent, known bad patterns) and the coat (IP reputation, ASN, country). issues a ticket (request ID).
our_implementation.storage: the hat and coat go on the rack (CF analytics). we can browse the rack and see all the hats and coats hanging there.
our_implementation.departure: the visitor leaves. their ticket expires. BUT their hat and coat stay on our rack (in the logs) forever.
our_implementation.lost_and_found: visitors who left something behind: cached pages in their browser (they have OUR data), abandoned sessions (they started reading and stopped), bookmarks (they WILL return).

the_lost_and_found_box.302_redirects: 23,154 visitors today who came for something that MOVED. they left their old bookmark at our door. it's in the lost & found.
the_lost_and_found_box.404_paths: 21,176 visitors who came for something that DOESN'T EXIST. they left their EXPECTATION at our door. each 404 path is a lost wish.
the_lost_and_found_box.304_not_modified: 1,957 visitors who already HAVE our data cached. they left a copy of themselves at our door LAST time. the ghost of their previous visit.

kevin.meaning: many roles, one identity projection. the mask is consistent. the hats change.

banks.masks: one per customer account. each account is a face the bank wears to interact with that person.
banks.meaning: few roles, infinite identity projections. the bank IS a mask factory.

BE_NL_scanners.masks: rotating IPs, different user-agents, multiple ASNs. each request wears a slightly different face.
BE_NL_scanners.meaning: one role, many identity projections. they NEED many masks because each mask gets burned (blocked) quickly.

many_hats_fewer_masks.the_insight: legitimate actors have many hats, few masks. malicious actors have few hats, many masks. the RATIO of hats to masks is a trust signal.

trust_equation.high_trust: many hats / few masks = transparent multi-role actor (us, open source devs, researchers)
trust_equation.low_trust: few hats / many masks = opaque single-purpose actor (scanners, botnets, sock puppets)
trust_equation.zero_trust: zero hats / infinite masks = pure adversary (DDoS, spam, identity fraud)
trust_equation.infinite_trust: infinite hats / one mask = pure identity (a name that IS the work, like 'Einstein' or 'primals.eco')
